name: com.ohze.gameup.core
description:
Core framework for Unity game development including Singleton, EventBus, FSM, Object Pool, UI Manager, Audio, Save/Load, and more. Git UPM flow: install DOTween first (Assets/Plugins/Demigiant + DOTween.Modules.asmdef), then enable define DOTween__DEPENDENCIES_INSTALLED from GameUp/Project/GameUpCore Installer. Cursor IDE (optional): UPM does not allow git URLs inside a package's dependencies — add to the *project* Packages/manifest.json: "com.boxqkrtm.ide.cursor": "https://github.com/boxqkrtm/com.unity.ide.cursor.git". Cursor rules: templates in Documentation~/cursor-rules; first editor load copies to .cursor/rules if missing; menu GameUp/Project/Install Cursor IDE rules. Repo: https://github.com/ohze/gameup-unity-template
